lines.text: Hello, can I exchange these shoes? One sole is loose.
lines.speaker: Wei

lines.text: They're size forty-one. Do you have a black pair in that size?
lines.speaker: Wei

lines.text: We only have brown, but it's the same price.
lines.speaker: Bo

lines.text: Do you have a lighter pair for work?
lines.speaker: Wei

lines.text: Yes. This black pair is lighter, but it's five dollars more.
lines.speaker: Bo

lines.text: Can I try the lighter pair on before I decide?
lines.speaker: Wei

lines.text: Of course. There's a seat by the mirror.
lines.speaker: Bo
